head: 710f0de1
snapshot_note: Worktree was edited by another process during the review (09:44-09:55). Final reviewed bytes are the family-scope snapshot with the SHAs below; the earlier 77-PASS snapshot without family gating is superseded. All findings were re-run on the final SHAs.
verdict_reason: Five P1 contract violations: declaration context is not delivered to the dependent card/task; carrier/original envelope namespace consumes the only real CN unique closure; declaration refs use matching-text offsets; proven cross-page flow is not wired and unproved order is reported complete; the in-material declaration shortcut ignores order/count. Safe defers and green tests do not close the positive path.

checks.question: only existing responsibility layers, no second detector/Store/budget/product lexicon
checks.evidence: No new Store/budget/detector; same WorkBudget. But product_reference.py:17-32 adds a second product-head lexicon overlapping patterns.py:404-410, and narrative_antecedent.py:65-117 re-derives window boundaries instead of reusing _prose_reading_packages continuity proof.

checks.question: state semantics; ambiguous never nearest-wins
checks.evidence: Six states exist; family competition returns ambiguous without nearest-wins (relations.py:862-865). But in-material shortcut is order/count-blind (relations.py:838-841); collective is derived from the first 包括/含 anywhere (product_reference.py:54-64,151-157); source_boundary/unproved_order keep complete=True (narrative_antecedent.py:96-111); attribution defaults to issuer.

checks.question: 8 units / 4 (source,page,pdf_block) / 2048 chars, same parent budget; only affected card deferred
checks.evidence: Constants correct (narrative_antecedent.py:14-17). Block key wrongly includes paragraph_index (133-137); carrier union undercounts (narrative_reading.py:522-527); carrier/original namespace mismatch false-fails envelope (512-513,526-527; narrative_antecedent.py:130-131); withheld flips whole-document status (narrative_reading.py:893-910); REFERENCE_* reasons truncated at 128 (927-930).

checks.question: original/analysis namespace; declaration refs stay original, not mis-mapped by _original_refs
checks.evidence: reference() bypasses _original_refs (narrative_operating_relations.py:147-192) and validates bounds (194-211). But declaration/member offsets are matching-text offsets (relations.py:851,868-872; text_view.py:55-70), only bounds are validated; analysis reference_refs are analysis coordinates (relations.py:836-837).

checks.question: cache key target + ordered predecessors + window_complete
checks.evidence: Engine key is correct (relations.py:796-798) and a test covers completeness/order (test_reference_closure.py:153-158). Session cache is keyed by owner only (narrative_operating_relations.py:154-157); declarations are re-scanned per target/predecessor (relations.py:851-855); receipts do not bind the three grammar modules (probe.py:48-63).

checks.question: do not bypass unread/opaque pages, headers/footers, table/QA boundaries
checks.evidence: Table/QA and blocked/excluded stop the run (narrative_antecedent.py:82,100-106). But page+1 always stops (54-62) and unproved_order still complete=True (96-111); proven furniture is not skipped; unknown coordinates count as adjacent (45-62).

checks.question: in-material declaration not missing; only declarations before the deictic
checks.evidence: Any declaration in target returns not_applicable (relations.py:838-841): declaration after the deictic is accepted, two internal families are accepted. The intended must-not-be-missing behavior holds, but the order/count requirement does not.

checks.question: no broad regression, especially plain paragraphs without deictics
checks.evidence: Plain paragraphs are unchanged (relations.py:834-835; probe [PLAIN,PLAIN] selected/coverage True). But one unresolved family deictic flips the whole document to partial/coverage False (probe [PLAIN,PLAIN,TARGET,PLAIN,PLAIN]; narrative_reading.py:893-910).

checks.question: tests truly cover RED->GREEN, no implementation-detail false green
checks.evidence: 79 focused tests pass. Missing forward declaration, internal ambiguity, matching-to-original offsets, carrier namespace, cross-page carry, _context/summary task context, attribution, document status. Two tests named 'defers only that card'/'attaches ... as context' assert only candidate/metadata and are false green for the contract.

checks.question: performance/budget: real CN 2518 reference calls, HK 13.17M/16M, repeated scans or avoidable O(N*K)
checks.evidence: Final-byte replay: CN 2518 calls (2515 NA, 1 missing, 1 unique, 1 partial), ref work 11,808, total 6,141,589/16M; HK 3578 calls all NA, ref work 18,658, total 13,171,440/16M (82.3%); US 1118 calls, ref work 7,073, total 7,993,452/16M. Declaration scans 26/2/12; CN 3198 windows/9376 predecessors. No blow-up; HK headroom 2.83M and group preparation before deictic check is minor waste.

findings.title: Declaration context is not delivered to the dependent card/task
findings.trigger: text_case([DECLARATION, TARGET]) + select_reading_evidence; any resolved predecessor-declaration card
findings.evidence: Both groups have evidence_ids=1 and citation_views=(1,0); the target summary task has context=[]. The declaration is a separate task, not context of the target.
findings.impact: Model receives a bare deictic task; contract 4.5/6.6 target=support, declaration=context is not satisfied.
findings.fix: Attach original declaration IDs to the original package required_context_unit_ids before _context; map carriers back to originals; make _context/citation views include them; add an end-to-end summary-task assertion.

findings.title: Envelope mixes carrier/original namespaces; real CN unique closure is falsely deferred
findings.trigger: A declaration whose original is folded into a native range carrier; target resolves unique and needed is mapped through origins to a carrier id.
findings.evidence: Real CN: unique required b5bf5b0c..., ENV ok=False, decl=[b8117bd8...], not_in_units=[b8117bd8...]; withheld reason REFERENCE_ENVELOPE. Plan task_plan.md:15 also reports CN REFERENCE_ENVELOPE 1.
findings.impact: The only real CN unique closure is discarded as if it exceeded the envelope; B2 positive path fails for carrier declarations.
findings.fix: Keep both namespaces explicit; count all originals of each carrier in the envelope (units/chars/blocks) or evaluate in carrier coordinates; never look up carrier ids in original_units; add a carrier regression fixture.

findings.title: Declaration/member refs use matching-text offsets, not original offsets
findings.trigger: Predecessor text contains CJK wrapping whitespace before the declaration, e.g. 公司持续投入研发\n公司推出Preforma Uniflash系列...
findings.evidence: Ref char_start=12 while the declaration starts at 13; raw_text[12:40] is left-shifted by one character. _validate_original_refs only checks bounds.
findings.impact: declaration_refs/member_refs are not exact source segments; contract 4/6.4 exact offsets violated; future consumers get wrong chars.
findings.fix: Match on raw text or map via MatchingView.to_original; validate parent/source/text identity; add CJK-wrap and Traditional replay tests.

findings.title: Proven cross-page source flow is not wired; unproved order is reported complete
findings.trigger: Declaration on p7, target on p8 in the same section/role, with an existing _prose_reading_packages/build_native_continuity proven flow.
findings.evidence: Window for p8: predecessors=(), complete=True, stop_reason=unproved_order; closure returns missing although the p7 declaration exists. page_carries/project_for are never passed from _candidates.
findings.impact: The primary cross-page B2 scenario cannot close; missing is inferred from an unexamined tail, violating 2/3.
findings.fix: Derive page_carries from the existing continuity proof (or reuse window membership); pass it from _candidates; map unproved_order to complete=False/partial; add proven/unproven two-page tests.

findings.title: In-material declaration shortcut ignores order and count
findings.trigger: A family deictic followed by a declaration in the same target, or two competing families in the target.
findings.evidence: Forward declaration -> not_applicable (expected missing); two internal families -> not_applicable (expected ambiguous).
findings.impact: Admits an unresolved deictic card, the exact failure B2 exists to prevent; forward declaration and ambiguity semantics violated (3/6.2).
findings.fix: Compute deictic spans first; accept only declarations ending before the deictic; declarations only after -> missing; >1 earlier family -> ambiguous; add forward/ambiguous/heading-only tests.

findings.title: One reference deferral flips whole-document status/coverage
findings.trigger: text_case([PLAIN, PLAIN, TARGET, PLAIN, PLAIN]) + select_reading_evidence
findings.evidence: status=partial, coverage_complete=False, spans=4; plain-only case stays selected/coverage True.
findings.impact: Any document with an unresolved family deictic is marked incomplete; contract 3 says only the affected package; downstream export/quality may be blocked.
findings.fix: Use a separate reference_deferred/diagnostics channel that does not participate in processing_complete; defer only the target card; add document-status tests.

findings.title: Unread/blocked boundaries and window/work failures are reported as proven absence
findings.trigger: blocked/excluded/unread predecessor, or WorkBudgetExceeded while building windows; or an anchor with no antecedents entry.
findings.evidence: complete stays True for source_boundary; windows={} and default ((), True) produce missing; stop_reason never unread/work/unknown_scope.
findings.impact: Definitive missing inferred from an unexamined tail; contract 2/3 violated.
findings.fix: Classify boundaries; use complete=False->partial for unread/unknown/work; propagate window failure as partial; session default complete=False.

findings.title: Envelope block key overcounts and carrier union undercounts
findings.trigger: Same page+pdf_block on 4 different paragraphs; or a carrier covering multiple originals.
findings.evidence: within_reference_envelope(...) returns False for same page+block 4 paragraphs; only inverse_origins[carrier][0] is counted.
findings.impact: False deferrals or undercount against (parent,page,pdf_block)/8-unit/2048-char contract.
findings.fix: Key (parent_id, page, pdf_block); count all carrier originals; add both boundary tests.

findings.title: Unknown coordinates are treated as adjacent
findings.trigger: Units without page/paragraph coordinates.
findings.evidence: _adjacent(no-coord, no-coord) returns True.
findings.impact: Unproved physical order can be borrowed as predecessor; contract 2 says stop at unproved ordering.
findings.fix: Return False/partial when coordinates are unknown; add a no-coordinate test.

findings.title: Collective members can come from an unrelated 包括/含 clause
findings.trigger: 公司客户包括华为、小米。公司推出X系列产品，已实现量产。
findings.evidence: X系列 is collective=True with members 华为/小米; the bare 含 alternative can match inside words.
findings.impact: Wrong collective status/member_refs; customers/non-products become product members.
findings.fix: Bind the collective marker to the declaration clause; require product-like members; compute per declaration; add a customer/region negative test.

findings.title: Attribution is always issuer; third-party/question attribution is not preserved
findings.trigger: A declaration attributed to a competitor/customer/related party, or a question-answer context.
findings.evidence: result() defaults attribution='issuer'; only role and 请问 are filtered; existing THIRD_PARTY/ISSUER_WORD/_classify_np are unused.
findings.impact: Rival/related-party declarations can donate an issuer antecedent; contract 3 attribution not met.
findings.fix: Reuse the existing NP/attribution classifier on the declaration clause; return issuer/quoted_related_party/other/unknown; missing/partial -> unknown; add three tests.

findings.title: Second product head lexicon diverges from PRODUCT_SUFFIX
findings.trigger: Any declaration whose head is only in one of the two lists (材料/添加剂/试剂/药品/equipment/line/... vs 系列/平台/方案/技术).
findings.evidence: Two overlapping but different head sets; plan task_plan.md:5 claims no second product dictionary.
findings.impact: Contract 1 'no product dictionary' risk; coverage drift and maintenance divergence.
findings.fix: Reuse/derive from PRODUCT_SUFFIX and keep family markers separate.

findings.title: REFERENCE_* reasons are truncated at 128; receipts do not bind the three grammar modules
findings.trigger: Real CN family-scope replay receipt.
findings.evidence: deferral_reasons shows only SELECTION_BUDGET:128 while instrumentation finds 2 unresolved + 1 envelope; source_bindings omit product_reference.py/relations.py/narrative_antecedent.py; plan says 78 PASS while the directory has 79.
findings.impact: The plan's t34/CN withheld claims cannot be verified from the receipt; the receipt cannot bind the reviewed grammar bytes.
findings.fix: Record deferred_count and full reason/status histogram before truncation; add the three modules to bindings; update the plan to the final SHA/test count.

findings.title: Readiness can raise WorkBudget/ValueError instead of deferring
findings.trigger: Budget near 16M, or a cross-parent analysis group (ValueError).
findings.evidence: The initial charge is outside the try; reference() catches only ValueError; _candidates has no try around the readiness loop.
findings.impact: Hard failure of select_reading_evidence at/near budget exhaustion instead of partial/defer; HK is at 82.3% of the cap.
findings.fix: Charge inside the try; catch WorkBudgetExceeded/ValueError and return partial; wrap per-package readiness in _candidates with defer.

findings.title: Tests miss the P1 behaviors and two green tests overstate their names
findings.trigger: Current focused suite.
findings.evidence: No forward/internal ambiguity/offset/carrier/cross-page/task/status tests; 'defers only that card' and 'attaches ... as context' assert only candidate/metadata; all five P1 behaviors pass the current green suite.
findings.impact: Green CI cannot establish contract compliance.
findings.fix: Add RED tests per P1 reproduction (see report section 3), then fix; preserve RED->GREEN evidence.

findings.title: Project/body descriptor boundaries are not wired as specified
findings.trigger: Same section with different projects/body regions.
findings.evidence: project_for is never passed; fallback uses tuple(sorted(str(section_key))) (a character multiset), not the project key; body_region_key/boundary_kind/predecessor_unit_id are absent.
findings.impact: Project/body boundaries depend indirectly on hints.section_key; contract 2 descriptor not implemented.
findings.fix: Pass the actual project tuple from prose ownership; add a project-boundary test; or document the section_key substitute with proof.

findings.title: member_refs choose the nearest same-family declaration
findings.trigger: Multiple declarations of the same family.
findings.evidence: member_refs = entries[-1].members; required includes all entries.
findings.impact: Member attribution may not match the earliest/complete declaration.
findings.fix: Define explicit member attribution (e.g., all entries or the earliest complete collective).

findings.title: Analysis-owner reference_refs are in analysis coordinates
findings.trigger: reference() on an analysis group owner.
findings.evidence: reference_refs use analysis text offsets and are not projected; consumers only use required_original_unit_ids today.
findings.impact: Schema says OriginalRef but contains analysis refs.
findings.fix: Project or explicitly mark as analysis refs; do not publish as OriginalRef.

findings.title: CJK declarations without 系列 are not recognized
findings.trigger: 公司推出新一代刻蚀设备，已实现量产。
findings.evidence: find_product_declarations() returns ().
findings.impact: Chinese unique product coverage is incomplete; family deictic with a non-series CJK declaration remains unresolved.
findings.fix: Clarify the contract; if needed, accept CJK appositives with a bounded pattern and tests.

findings.title: window_complete defaults to True in the engine API
findings.trigger: Caller omits window_complete.
findings.evidence: Default is True; completeness must be proven, not assumed.
findings.impact: A caller can assert complete closure by omission.
findings.fix: Make window_complete required or default False.

findings.title: analysis_groups built twice
findings.trigger: Any native analysis view.
findings.evidence: Duplicate construction in _candidates.
findings.impact: Maintenance/drift risk.
findings.fix: Build once and reuse.

findings.title: stop_reason misses contract enum values
findings.trigger: Unread/work/unknown scope.
findings.evidence: Only beginning/source_boundary/cap/unproved_order are emitted.
findings.impact: Diagnostics cannot distinguish unread vs boundary.
findings.fix: Emit unread/work/unknown_scope.

findings.title: _validate_original_refs checks only bounds
findings.trigger: A ref with valid bounds but wrong parent/text.
findings.evidence: No parent/source/text identity check.
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap.
findings.fix: Validate parent and exact source text.

findings.title: Session references cache collapses different anchors
findings.trigger: Two anchors of the same analysis owner with different antecedents.
findings.evidence: references keyed by owner only.
findings.impact: Wrong scope may be reused.
findings.fix: Key by (owner, ordered predecessors, complete) or document the group-level equivalence.

findings.title: Envelope test title overstates 2048/4-block coverage
findings.trigger: Current test.
findings.evidence: Uses 3x1025 chars; no exact 2048/2049, no 9/5 first excess, no paragraph-key case.
findings.impact: False confidence.
findings.fix: Add exact inclusive/excess tests.

findings.title: Declaration scans are not cached per unit
findings.trigger: Many targets sharing predecessors.
findings.evidence: find_product_declarations called per target/predecessor; measured 26/2/12 scans on CN/HK/US.
findings.impact: Minor avoidable work; not a budget risk today.
findings.fix: Cache declarations by unit identity.

commands.result: 3 modified source files + 4 new files (2 src, 2 tests); unrelated pre-existing untracked files untouched.
79 passed in 3.67s on the final snapshot; 77 passed on the 09:30 snapshot before the author added family gating/tests. Full unit not run.

commands.cmd: synthetic probes via Python stdin (no file writes)
commands.result: Forward declaration not_applicable; two internal families not_applicable; CJK-wrap ref start 12 vs expected 13; cross-page window empty/complete/unproved_order -> missing; no-coordinate adjacent=True; same page+block different paragraphs envelope False; unrelated 包括 collective members 华为/小米; CJK declaration empty; singular family=False vs plural family=True.
Resolved case: selected, 2 groups with evidence_ids=1, citation_views=(1,0), target task context=[]; unresolved among plains: partial/coverage False/4 spans; plain-only: selected/coverage True.

commands.cmd: read-only real-source replay (probe.py, socket blocked, REAL_LLM=0, output to system temp)
commands.result: CN 6141589/16M, 2518 reference calls (2515 NA, 1 missing, 1 unique, 1 partial), unique envelope false with declaration b8117... not in original_units; HK 13171440/16M, 3578 NA; US 7993452/16M, 1118 NA; original/gold unchanged, 0 API.

unverified: Full unit/contract/CI/publish: not run (another process is running them; user forbade full unit).
Formal content C / provider calls: not run by design; no semantic content acceptance.
Whether the real CN unique case would still exceed 4 blocks/2048 chars after fixing the carrier namespace; cannot tell until fixed.
Whether the existing continuity proof can supply page_carries covering the real t34 cross-page case; not changed/verified. CN t34 is cap-partial, not cross-page.
Whether the three new grammar modules enter a runtime selection cache; no module-hash cache key found, selector version remains 0.9.0.
Whether the family-only scope is the contract owner's intended reading of 'Chinese unique product' (plan says yes; contract 6.2 ambiguous).
Whether the author preserved RED->GREEN ordering; only the final green suite is visible (no git operations performed).
Whether the family-scope receipts were produced by exactly these three grammar module SHAs; bindings omit them, although work totals match independent replay.
How much of the HK 13.17M/16M is attributable to B2; no pre-B2 same-source baseline was measured.
notes: Worktree changed during review; final SHAs are pinned in changed_files. The earlier 77-PASS snapshot lacked the family filter; findings tied to singular gating were withdrawn.
No repository file other than this report pair was written. Real-source probe outputs went to a system temp directory; no source/gold/config or git state was modified.
